item.title: Brand New Stock: AI Drone-Defense IPO
item.description: A brand new stock just debuted in the hottest sector we’ve seen in years. It’s an AI drone-defense play in the middle of a war in the Middle East. And the fact that it’s an IPO makes it even more volatile.

item.title: The Crypto Turf War Could Finally Be Ending
item.description: For most of crypto’s history, its rules of governance in the U.S. have been ambiguous. Ian says a historic agreement aims to correct this.

item.title: 3 Things My Millionaire Students Have in Common
item.description: You don’t have to work on Wall Street to make money in the stock market. My millionaire students come from all walks of life. Mariana and Jack Schwartz started right after high school graduation.

item.title: What a Dog’s Cancer Reveals About the Future of AI
item.description: The fight against cancer has always been defined by trial and error. But Ian says an Australian dog's story reveals how AI could change this.

item.title: My #1 Fix for Gains in the Stock Market
item.description: The best trade setup in the stock market repeats over and over again. So that’s all I do … I trade the same price action on the same stocks, and I’ve done it for over two decades. 90% of traders lose because they get bored waiting for the same old setup. They go rogue and try to squeeze cash out of a sketchy spiker.

item.title: 4 Minutes for “Quick Hits” Profits
item.description: We’re seeing a lot of spikers, but in this choppy market, they’re only spiking for 1, 2 … maybe 3 hours. Some plays aren’t even spiking for an hour (like when shorts get squeezed)… Try 4 minutes. So, you have to recognize what’s going on.

item.title: Are We Running Out of Space in Space?
item.description: The more satellites we launch, the more crowded Earth’s orbit becomes. Ian warns that this crowding is starting to become a real problem.

item.title: Simple Rules That Helped Mariana Reach $1 Million
item.description: Mariana is a trailblazing student. Not only is she my first female millionaire student, but also the youngest. She was just 20 years old when she passed seven figures in trading profits.

item.title: Chart of the Week: The $1 Trillion AI Surge
item.description: A year ago, the big question about AI was whether it would live up to the hype. Ian says the question now is whether the world can keep up.

item.description: Right now, the best pattern I see is buying short squeezes. And THIS short squeeze was EPIC. I’m sure you’ve heard about short squeezes (I talked about them last week). But how do you recognize one in the heat of the moment?

item.description: Andrej Karpathy's autoresearch tool can write, test and refine code all on its own. Ian says it's starting to look like an early form of AGI.

item.title: 1 Trading Strategy for Volatile Markets
item.description: In the world of trading, a stock market reversal is a significant change in the price direction of a stock or the market as a whole. This could be an uptrend changing to a downtrend, or vice versa. It’s a pivotal moment for traders, as it can signal a new trading opportunity.
